{{Tabs|History = No}} {{SameName|Skeleton|[[Skeleton|Enemy]] • [[Skeleton (Lunar Overture)|Lunar Overture]] • [[Skeleton (Unit)|Unit]]}} {{For|other uses of [[Skeleton (Disambiguation)|Skeleton]]}} {{UnitInfobox |title1 = Skeleton |image-static = Skeletonlunar.png |image-dynamic = SkeletonDynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Necromancer]]
[[Necromancer's Tome (Consumable)|Necromancer's Tome]] |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]90 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]2 |damage_type = Collision |speed = 4 |hidden = No |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Skeleton''' is a basic unit spawned from the [[Necromancer]]'s Level 1 gravestones and randomly from dead enemies while the [[Necromancer's Tome (Consumable)|Necromancer's Tome]] consumable is active. It can deal damage to enemies by colliding with them. ==Appearance== The '''Skeleton''' is made entirely of white parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has a partial ribcage. Its head is slightly smaller than most other enemies, and it has two large black eyeholes. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:MageSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:FallenSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:DuckSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:CreepySantaSkeleton.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Deluxe|Mage}} |{{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} |{{Color|DuckyRevenge|Duck}} |{{Color|FinalAct|Creepy Santa}} |- !Obtained From |[[Deluxe Crate]] |[[Mission Quests]] |[[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Premium Battle Pass]] |[[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Regular Battle Pass]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Skeleton''' is mainly useful against weaker enemies, like the [[Speedy]], [[Abnormal]] or [[Heavy]]. **Multiple of them can also do decently against the [[Normal Boss]] or [[Elite Abnormal]]. *The '''Skeleton''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Heavy]] or [[Abnormal Boss]]. *The '''Skeleton''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units because of its low health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King]] uses its ''Sword Swing'' attack, and a '''Skeleton''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly killed. ==Trivia== *The '''Skeleton''' shares the same model as the [[Skeleton (Lunar Overture)|Skeleton]] from the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''31 October 2023''' -
